rationale: The customer described a textbook musty-smell washer-dryer complaint, which is fully in scope and almost always resolved by simple homeowner checks (seal fold, drawer, filter, wash temperatures, softener use, drum clean). The assistant declined outright ('I can't diagnose that problem... here yet'), asked no questions, and pushed the customer toward an engineer for a non-fault maintenance issue, which is an inappropriate escalation. It invented nothing and recommended no part, but it gave the homeowner zero useful progress; the generic burning/sparking boilerplate was irrelevant to the stated symptom.
